answer: Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the mesa audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the falcon band is published for each class. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 135 to 239 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the garden identity is graded at all. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
